name: 78133 · Canyon Lake, TX
findings: ZIP 78133 (Canyon Lake) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78133 (Canyon Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78133 (Canyon Lake) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
